bio: My research focuses on Adaptive Human-AI Collaboration via Agentic Systems. I work across Human-AI collaboration, coding agents, developer personalization, context and memory, knowledge graphs, repository-level agents, adaptive LLM assistance, agent evaluation, model orchestration, and efficient LLM systems. At ITMO, I combine research direction and publications with hands-on system architecture, implementation, infrastructure, experimentation, and evaluation.
supervision: I also supervise students at ITMO.
